chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated, saying: I heard Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام say: My father narrated to me.
That the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed tawaf on his mount, touched the Stone with his staff, and performed sa‘y upon it between al-Safa and al-Marwah.

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safa, one of the two points of sa‘y
key_terms.الْحَجَرَ: the Black Stone touched during tawaf
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other point of sa‘y
key_terms.بِمِحْجَنِهِ: with his staff or hooked stick
key_terms.رَاحِلَتِهِ: his riding mount used during the ritual
key_terms.وَسَعَى: performed sa‘y between al-Safa and al-Marwah

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform tawaf and sa‘y while mounted?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed tawaf while mounted, touched al-Hajar with a staff, and performed sa‘y between al-Safa and al-Marwah on his mount. It serves as a precedent in the rites of hajj and shows the permissibility of performing these acts while riding.
